note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. An exploded front elevation of a fictional two-compartment file box: the original file (with a placeholder decision sheet whose content is never shown) and the proposed additional pieces lift out of their own compartments on either side of a neutral divider plate that decides nothing. Only the supplied relationships are drawn; plain relations have no arrowhead and causal styles appear only when supplied. The two supplied states (● on bundle A, ◆ on bundle B) have equal weight. No admissibility rule, assessment, time limit, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes (the captions of the two bundles and the divider), outcomes, elements (the index card and the calendar; an entry may also override a bundle's caption), relationships, focusElement, relationLabels and traversalOrder are editable.
